messages:
Ravi S: ReleaseBot blocked push for redwood/frontend:staging-2026-03-21-try4 
ReleaseBot: publish blocked — provenance.signature != registry.manifest (digest mismatch) — see /runbooks/provenance-ops 
Jen W: This popped up during the scheduled staging promotion. CI logs show the multi-arch manifest was produced, signed, and then pushed, but registry reports a different manifest digest. Anyone see replication issues? 
BuilderBot: note — builder pool reported transient network error at 15:22 UTC on 2026-03-21; some push retries occurred. 
Ava M: Likely the retry path created a slightly different manifest (ordering/annotation), so cosign signature doesn't align. We should avoid rebuilding. Proposal: manual-pin tag to the digest that passed E2E tests (sha256:d3f4...), annotate with release:manual-pin and buildid, and let ReleaseBot re-run verification using pinned artifact. 
Ravi S: Agreed. Manual-pin flow: operator must include `release:manual-pin` and `reason:push-retry-manifest-drift` in the Deploy comment. Also schedule a 20m hold on the canary window. 
ReleaseBot: advisory — manual pin allowed; action audited. Add build link in comment. 
Jen W: I'll perform the copy now. Commands: 
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository redwood/frontend --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:d3f4... --output json > manifest.json 
# then put with same manifest and new tag
aws ecr put-image --repository redwood/frontend --image-manifest file://manifest.json --image-tag staging-2026-03-21-pinned 
Jen W: pinned and submitted for re-verify. Comment to ReleaseBot: "release:manual-pin reason:push-retry-manifest-drift buildid=20260321-77" 
ReleaseBot: verification passed for staging-2026-03-21-pinned — provenance OK :white_check_mark: 
Ava M: Good. Follow-ups: (1) add a CI pre-push check to compute manifest bytes and compare signed digest before any retry path overwrites, (2) add a short guard to retry logic to preserve deterministic ordering/annotations, (3) run a quick sweep of other pushes around 15:22 UTC to see if any other tags drifted. 
Ravi S: I'll open a small incident with the action items and assign to infra/ci. Jen, please paste the put-image logs into the incident. 
Jen W: done — logs + Deploy comment in incident. Adding the release note: "Staging promotion briefly held due to manifest drift after retry; manual pin applied to preserve verified artifact." 
Ava M: Nice mitigation. Closing thread once incident has PR link for the CI guard.
